text: Healthy living means taking care of both your body and your mind. A balanced diet with plenty of fruit, vegetables and water gives you energy and helps you stay well. Regular exercise, such as walking or cycling, keeps your body strong and reduces stress. It is also important to get enough sleep, because good rest helps you think clearly and feel better. Mental health matters just as much as physical health, so take time to relax and talk about your feelings. Finally, try to keep a good work-life balance. When you spend time on things you enjoy, you feel happier and more relaxed.
